ApplicantHistory.description: FR-004-16: every coverage period's decision with the explanation given at the time.
ApplicantHistory.title: ApplicantHistory

ApplicationSubmission.description: API body; the household comes from the session, never from the body.
ApplicationSubmission.title: ApplicationSubmission

CaseNoticeView.description: A notice of a case as staff see it, including one still waiting for approval (FR-007-03).
CaseNoticeView.title: CaseNoticeView

CaseStatus.description: Query result `status` and API response. `at_risk` is derived from `days_remaining`.
CaseStatus.title: CaseStatus

result.description: null until the check has run

Correction.description: A caseworker's correction of one entered detail (FR-002-19).
Correction.title: Correction

DecisionExplanation.description: One audience's explanation, stored in `decision_explanations` as built (FR-004-13).
DecisionExplanation.title: DecisionExplanation

DeterminationView.description: Read model of a stored determination for the case page (FR-003-23, ADR-003-05).
DeterminationView.title: DeterminationView

Finding.description:
One discrepancy (FR-002-03, FR-002-14, FR-002-24). `finding_id` is derived from the case,
cause, member, job and document, so running the check again gives the same ID (FR-002-23)
and two "different person" stubs (no member, no job) still get different IDs.
`identity` is set for identity mismatches: `no_match` or `no_record` (FR-002-24).
Finding.title: Finding

FindingCause.description: FR-002-16: the causes a "Verification review" task shows.
FindingCause.title: FindingCause

HouseholdView.description: FR-007-18: members, coverage periods and cases.
HouseholdView.title: HouseholdView

MetricsReport.description: FR-008-09: metric values only, no names or identifiers.
MetricsReport.title: MetricsReport

MissingDocument.description: Named apart from 003's `MissingItem`, which the OpenAPI document already uses.
MissingDocument.title: MissingDocument

MissingDocumentKind.description: FR-002-15: a declared job with no pay stub, or whose latest stub is too old.
MissingDocumentKind.title: MissingDocumentKind

NoticeType.description:
FR-011-06 (MVP: no redetermination form, 007b is dropped). Which types wait for a
caseworker is `NOTICE_NEEDS_APPROVAL` in `packages/domain/notice.py`.
NoticeType.title: NoticeType

OpenRequest.description: An approved request for information the applicant has not answered (FR-011-10).
OpenRequest.title: OpenRequest

PayStubDetails.description:
What the applicant typed for one uploaded pay stub (FR-002-21). `member_id` is the
household member the employee name matched, or None (FR-002-14).
PayStubDetails.title: PayStubDetails

PayStubUpload.description:
Step 1 of an upload: the details the applicant typed (FR-002-21). Step 2 sends the file's
bytes to `PUT /cases/{case_id}/documents/{document_id}/content`.
PayStubUpload.title: PayStubUpload

PendingTimer.description: The case's next timer, on the case clock. "Advance clock" fires it (FR-011-05).
PendingTimer.title: PendingTimer

created.description: false when one was already running for the period
created.title: Created

RequestResponseBody.description: The applicant's answer: documents uploaded first (002's endpoints), then confirmed items.
RequestResponseBody.title: RequestResponseBody

RequestedItem.description: One thing a request for information asks for (FR-011-12).
RequestedItem.title: RequestedItem

ReviewActionBody.description:
A caseworker's action. The reviewer comes from the session, never from the body.

`reason` is never logged or echoed in an error (PL-11).
ReviewActionBody.title: ReviewActionBody

VerificationResult.description:
Output of `verify_documents` (FR-002-23).

`complete` and `needs_review` keep the names of 001's `VerificationOutcome`, and every
added field has a default, so recorded workflow histories still replay (TW-14).
`identity_verified` is None when the check did not look at identity (the 001 stub).
VerificationResult.title: VerificationResult
